results.name: SummitTX Pinnacle (fka Crestline Summit Pinnacle)
results.strategy_description:
SummitTX Pinnacle (“Pinnacle”) -- Targets net returns of the risk-free rate plus 600-1000 bps and 6-9% volatility. Pinnacle is an “enhanced” version of SummitTX’s original SummitTX Alpha. Pinnacle was launched in response to investor demand for a solution that utilizes the same process and investment teams as SummitTX Alpha but employs a larger gross balance sheet, generally 1.65x larger or typically with gross exposure of 400-600% with little net market exposure. The solution was launched in May 2024. AUM is currently ~$900 million.

SummitTX employs an open architecture, multi-manager, multi-strategy equity-oriented, market-neutral platform managing over $3 billion across three unique risk/reward solutions harnessing the same investment process and portfolio. SummitTX currently utilizes 1) Fundamental, 2) Tactical, 3) Quantitative, and 4) Capital Markets investment strategies. In addition, SummitTX employs an Office of the CIO portfolio implementing upsizing, alpha capture, and hedging/portfolio overlays to manage market and factor exposure.

Caroline Cooley, Chief Investment Officer and Managing Partner, leads the investment team and business overall. Neilson Arbour is the Deputy Chief Investment Officer.

SummitTX also offers a smaller balance sheet version relative to Pinnacle called SummitTX Alpha.  SummitTX Alpha — Targets net returns of the risk-free rate plus 400-600 bps and 4-6% volatility. 

Finally, SummitTX also offers a beta one / portable alpha in-a-box solution that aims to deliver the total return of the chosen benchmark (S&P 500 or Nasdaq 100) plus adding 400-600 basis points net annually.

results.name: Triata China Equity Master Fund
results.strategy_description:
Triata China Equity Master Fund is a Greater China-focused equity long/short fund that seeks to maximize absolute returns. We run a fundamental strategy focusing on bottom-up stock picking with a concentrated Long portfolio. We look for businesses which operate in a large TAM and have  a sustainable competitive advantage that would continue to compound through time by on the ground due diligence, deep sector research and alternative data. This includes meeting management, channel checking upstream/ downstream, using the products/platforms, etc. We believe in being focused and investing for the long-term. We believe our strength is in identifying investment opportunities driven by Chinese theme / consumers and we hold a concentrated portfolio. When we buy shares of a company we are buying into a slice of the business. Our investment universe includes China A, H shares, ADR and other related Chinese theme names. 

We believe our competitive edge lies in our focus on deep fundamental research strengthening by triangulating alternative data to form long-term investment thesis. We look to take advantage of the large amount of alternative data that we can track in China to help inform our fundamental research and have an information edge. We believe in being contrarian to achieve above average returns. We focus our research efforts on the bigger unknowns 3-10 years out to form a better understanding on the company and sector in the long term. It requires some creativity and imagination. It is also at this time horizon, we find the biggest delta on our assumptions and alpha capture opportunities. 

We believe it is important to have a disciplined and repeatable investment process and emphasize continuous learning. In terms of organisation of research efforts, we have an investment team of 8 people including CIO, 3 analysts and 4 data analysts who work in a collaborative team based approach. Each analyst will work with a data analyst on a name/sector and work closely together in their fundamental research. All the research work is documented comprehensively in our research management system. They would present their long/short recommendation in the IC meetings after working on the idea for at least 2 months and they would be challenged by the team in the meeting. 

While we cannot predict future performance, we think in a bear market the fund would underperform but protect the capital through its short alpha and in a bull market the fund would outperform.

The Fund has a significant real estate focus and invests primarily in North America, including a focus on market inefficiencies unique to Canada and selectively in the United States. Where appropriate, Vision will seek to be an active investor by utilizing the combination of its real estate experience together with its capital market knowledge and relationships to benefit the Fund. The Fund may be selectively concentrated in Vision's best ideas as it seeks to identify specific opportunities to capitalize on the arbitrage between private and public real estate valuations. Portfolio investments in the Fund can be long or short, although Vision has historically had a majority of investments as long holdings reflecting the aforementioned market inefficiencies which will enable the Fund to have exposure to real estate investment more cheaply through the stock market than in the property market.

Vision uses an active management approach to achieve the Fund’s investment objectives of generating consistently favorable risk-adjusted total returns to investors. Vision employs numerous quantitative and qualitative factors to identify and profit from trends and mispriced securities that do not adequately reflect the underlying value and growth prospects of the issuer.

Vision's investment strategy seeks out undervalued or overvalued corporations/REITs both absolutely and relative to their peers. The strategy involves the identification of corporations’/REITs’ Net Asset Value (NAV) of the underlying real estate as compared to the pricing of its equity (or debt) securities. Focusing on NAV: i) avoids excessive and myopic focus on near-term earnings and cash flow; and, ii) assesses impact from (undervalued or off-balance sheet) assets which do not have current earnings or liabilities which may not be sufficiently understood.

The strategy utilizes a combination of “top-down” and “bottom-up” approaches to pinpoint investment opportunities. A top-down strategy for assessing asset sectors or regions, and a bottom-up approach to select specific investments based on the merits of the specific entity and preference for internalized and aligned management. Vision also assesses balance sheet considerations including near-term liquidity factors. The strategy also involves investments in debt, convertible debt, and preferred shares, particularly when equity-like returns are available with a lower level of risk.

results.strategy_description:
Vision Strategic Opportunity Fund Limited Partnership (the "Fund") has a significant real estate focus and invests primarily in North America, including a focus on market inefficiencies unique to Canada and selectively in the United States. Where appropriate, Vision will seek to be an active investor by utilizing the combination of its real estate experience together with its capital market knowledge and relationships to benefit the Fund. The Fund may be selectively concentrated in Vision's best ideas as it seeks to identify specific opportunities to capitalize on the arbitrage between private and public real estate valuations. Portfolio investments in the Fund can be long or short, although Vision has historically had a majority of investments as long holdings reflecting the aforementioned market inefficiencies which will enable the Fund to have exposure to real estate investment more cheaply through the stock market than in the property market.

Vision uses an active management approach to achieve the Fund’s investment objectives of generating consistently favorable risk-adjusted total returns to investors. Vision employs numerous quantitative and qualitative factors to identify and profit from trends and mispriced securities that do not adequately reflect the underlying value and growth prospects of the issuer.

Vision's investment strategy seeks out undervalued or overvalued corporations/REITs both absolutely and relative to their peers. The strategy involves the identification of corporations’/REITs’ Net Asset Value (NAV) of the underlying real estate as compared to the pricing of its equity (or debt) securities. Focusing on NAV: i) avoids excessive and myopic focus on near-term earnings and cash flow; and, ii) assesses impact from (undervalued or off-balance sheet) assets which do not have current earnings or liabilities which may not be sufficiently understood.

The strategy utilizes a combination of “top-down” and “bottom-up” approaches to pinpoint investment opportunities. A top-down strategy for assessing asset sectors or regions, and a bottom-up approach to select specific investments based on the merits of the specific entity and preference for internalized and aligned management. Vision also assesses balance sheet considerations including near-term liquidity factors. The strategy also involves investments in debt, convertible debt, and preferred shares, particularly when equity-like returns are available with a lower level of risk.

results.name: Bay Pond Partners, L.P.
results.strategy_description:
Bay Pond seeks capital appreciation by investing in both long and short positions primarily in the financial services and related sectors. The portfolio invests primarily in financial services companies such as banks, thrifts, mortgage banks, commercial and consumer finance firms, brokerage firms, insurance companies, REITs, and related companies.

The investment strategy is to take aggressive, long positions in undervalued companies in the financial services and related sectors that may offer attractive investment opportunities. Such opportunities may be created by market fragmentation, the trend toward consolidation in the financial services sector, the relative obscurity of smaller companies, or investor misunderstanding of fundamental financial characteristics. The approach also takes short positions in financial services companies and related sectors as a hedge against specific long positions and try to take advantage of specific opportunities created by market disequilibrium. Securities for the portfolio are selected primarily on the basis of fundamental value. The strategy focuses on companies with strong fundamental characteristics that are undervalued relative to their long-term potential, specifically analyzing the relationship between a company's underlying earnings power and the market price of the stock. Attractive valuations are often found in securities issued by institutions that are not widely followed by institutional research analysts. Bay Pond makes investments throughout the capital structure (e.g., preferred, convertibles, fixed income) and seeks to invest in companies with solid fundamentals and attractive valuations, while shorting securities in those companies with unsustainable valuations. The approach utilizes a wide range of hedging techniques to potentially enhance returns, mitigate risk, and limit downside.

International Research Equity Extended is a long/short equity fund that seeks to outperform the MSCI EAFE Index consistently over market cycles through stock selection by a team of experienced industry-focused sub-portfolio managers. Each sub-portfolio manager is responsible for a sleeve of the fund, investing within their industries of expertise. The fund will aim to maintain a net exposure of 100%. Whitebox may sell short the instrument it believes is overpriced and buy the instrument it believes is underpriced. As pricing inefficiencies persist or become resolved, Whitebox positions are modified accordingly - holding positions that continue to be undervalued and closing positions that become priced more efficiently. Whitebox's investment portfolio generally consists of long positions in debt or preferred equity securities, which are offset with short positions in junior securities, usually the underlying equity security related to the long position. X Cubed Higher Moment is a single credit fund run jointly by Andrew, Chris Bemis and Toby Maitland Hudson. 
The fund is run through an integrated quantitative and fundamental framework to find cross-market dislocations for the same or highly connected underlying risk – often illuminated by volatility.
The portfolio is anchored in credit with some equity and volatility exposure. Package trades combine securities to isolate edge and as much as possible hedge out exposure to the underlying.
All trading is discretionary and relies on quantitative trading signals and mathematically modeled sizing.

management_company.description:
Founded in August 2021, X Cubed is an alternative asset manager focused on relative value across a broad spectrum of credit. We pursue an alpha-driven, low correlation return stream with superior left tail characteristics to more traditionally hedged credit exposures.  
The hallmarks of our approach to credit include:
* Unifying pricing and risk framework that allows us to pursue dislocations across a broad array of capital structures. Focused on novel or overlooked correlations including structured vs. regular-way credit and credit vs volatility. 
* Incorporation of systematic credit in a way that overcomes its known shortcomings and takes advantage of the signals it generates in other discretionary trading sleeves.
* Disciplined sizing. We use the Kelly Criterion to size positions according to potential Edge and risk in that Edge. Overcomes what we believe is a persistent tendency among credit managers to oversize their favorite positions.
* Capitalizing on the leading technical in credit markets: Credit Portfolio Trading. The advantages in execution, pricing and hedging efficiency from trading baskets of credits vs single names have been transformative to our business.
The Investment Committee of Andy Redleaf (Founder and previously founder of Deephaven and Whitebox), Chris Bemis (Managing Partner, Head of Quant previously at Whitebox) and Toby Maitland Hudson (Head of Markets and Trading and previously of Millennium and Saba) has over 80 years of collective experience in the markets and prides itself on being accessible to investors.
X Cubed is 100% owned by management with no external seed or revenue share agreements.
